tasks.label: Compilar Party Game
args: $ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path '${workspaceFolder}/build' | Out-Null; $files = @(Get-ChildItem -Path '${workspaceFolder}' -Recurse -Filter '*.cpp' | Where-Object { $_.FullName -notmatch '[\\/]build[\\/]' -and $_.FullName -notmatch '[\\/]\.vscode[\\/]' } | Select-Object -ExpandProperty FullName); Write-Host ('Compilando ' + $files.Count + ' archivos C++...'); & 'C:/msys64/ucrt64/bin/g++.exe' @files '-std=c++17' '-Wall' '-Wextra' '-g' '-I' '${workspaceFolder}' '-o' '${workspaceFolder}/build/Party.exe' '-lraylib' '-lopengl32' '-lgdi32' '-lwinmm'; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }; Write-Host 'Compilacion completada.'
